d:
This is a translation of the second half of "Magical Girls Lovely and Sweet". I only did the second story as I just wanted to translate an untranslated Satyr/Medu pairing.

This is my first released translation, and is human-done and not MTL. Any wonkyness in phrasal choice, typesetting etc is entirely my own. Comments recommending any better practices will be welcomed if you have them.
n: [Doujinshi] [Show-Taku-Ya! (Syoutaku)] Mahou Shoujo no Lovely and Sweet | Magical Girls Lovely and Sweet [Story 2: Satyr and Medusa] (Granblue Fantasy) [English] [Digital]  [Incomplete]
